notes.title: Revamped School Level: New Objectives, Polished Experience
notes.content:
Greetings, Courageous Seekers of the Unknown!

We're thrilled to present a major update that takes your 'School' level experience to new heights. This time, we've gone the extra mile, offering optional objectives that make this haunting adventure more complete than ever.

Explore every spine-tingling corner as you pursue these fresh objectives, uncovering the secrets that have long lingered within the eerie walls of the school. From jump scares to eerie atmospheres, you're in for a pulse-pounding experience that you won't soon forget.

As you delve deeper into the enigma of the 'School' level, prepare for an adrenaline-charged journey that will test your wits and bravery. Can you emerge from this nightmare unscathed?

Welcome back, and get ready for an unforgettable adventure through this fully polished level. Face your fears, explore with purpose, and conquer the unknown.

notes.title: 🌟 Exciting News! Fantôme Release Date Reveal 🌟
notes.content:
Dear Fantôme Community,

As we step into the new year of 2024, we're thrilled to announce that Fantôme is set to launch on January 18th! 🚀 This marks the culmination of our collective journey, and your unwavering support has been our driving force.

The development team has poured heart and soul into every detail, ensuring an immersive and spine-chilling experience for all players. Your feedback, dedication, and patience have fueled this journey, and we're immensely grateful.

This final update represents the culmination of our efforts. We've fine-tuned, polished, and added new elements to make Fantôme an unforgettable horror adventure. Thank you for staying with us on this thrilling ride.

Get ready to step into the abyss on January 18th, 2024. Your journey into the darkness awaits! 🌑

As we embark on this new year, we extend warm New Year's greetings to you and your loved ones. Know that our commitment to providing you with updates, both before and after the launch, remains unwavering. We're eager to continue this adventure together.

With sincere appreciation,

Gloac Games

notes.title: Optional Objectives & Crying Souls Hunt Update
notes.content:
Hello, Fearless Seekers!

In this major update, we're introducing a game-changing feature. Now, when you hit the escape button to open the pause menu, you'll uncover a world of hidden objectives waiting to be tackled. As part of this update, we're adding a gripping optional objective: search for the lost crying souls hidden in the chilling woods. Completing this task will banish one of the guarding ghosts from the dark relics, altering the very fabric of your haunting experience. But that's not all—we've fine-tuned animations and scripts for ghost guards and the menacing madman. Ghost guards approach you more seamlessly, intensifying the gameplay. The madman's attack animations and scripts have been optimized, ensuring an even more heart-pounding encounter.

These improvements aim to make your journey through Fantôme smoother, more informative, and genuinely terrifying. We deeply appreciate your feedback and are committed to delivering a horror experience that keeps you coming back for more.

Thank you for being a part of the Fantôme community. Stay vigilant, stay terrified, and embrace the darkness.

notes.title: Fantôme Returns: An All-New Horror Experience
notes.content:
Prepare to be immersed in a nightmarish world like never before as Fantôme returns with a complete overhaul. The entire experience has been reimagined, bringing forth an all-new level of fear and horror.

What's New:

Redesigned Lobby: Step into a revamped lobby environment, setting the tone for what lies ahead. A fresh atmosphere teeming with foreboding, it's your gateway to a world where terror reigns.

Reimagined Map and Mode: The heart of Fantôme has transformed. Explore a new, more chilling map that promises unforeseen horrors at every turn. The mode itself has evolved, offering an entirely different dimension of fear.

Enhanced Gameplay: Brace yourself for relentless challenges and horrifying encounters. Fantôme now delivers an intensified horror experience, making every decision a matter of life and death.

Immersive Horror: The fear has returned, more potent and vivid than ever. Enhanced graphics and audio plunge you deeper into the abyss, ensuring that terror surrounds you at every moment.

Multiplayer Mayhem: Team up with friends in co-op mode and compete to see who can withstand the horrors or venture forth solo into the abyss of fear.

Gameplay Details:

In Fantôme, you'll navigate through a world teeming with horrors. Your choices will shape your destiny as you explore chilling environments, and confront malevolent forces. With gameplay reimagined, every decision holds life-or-death consequences.

Face Unseen Terrors: Encounter a variety of horrifying creatures and twisted apparitions. Survival requires wit, courage, and a willingness to delve deeper into the unknown.

Procedural Challenges: The horrors are unpredictable, thanks to procedural objectives. No two playthroughs are alike, keeping you on the edge of your seat.

The Fear Resurrected: Enhanced graphics and audio will plunge you into an abyss of fear. Every creak, every whisper, and every shadow will keep you guessing.

Fantôme promises a haunting journey where every step could be your last. Will you emerge victorious, or will the darkness claim you? Face a new level of fear, and may you survive the nightmare.

notes.title: The Countdown Begins: Fantôme, Update on the Horizon!
notes.content:
Hello Fantôme Community,

We want to apologize for our prolonged silence since our last update on August 19, 2022. Internal challenges prevented us from communicating, and we deeply regret any frustration this caused.

We're thrilled to announce that during this time, we've been hard at work redeveloping Fantôme. Our focus has shifted towards enhancing the player experience by introducing single-player gameplay and LAN functionality.

We're excited to share that the new update is nearly complete and will be delivered this month. We can't wait for you to explore the improved world of Fantôme, which includes the new map of the game "Rajbari."

Thank you for your patience and continued support. Stay tuned for more updates!

Best regards,
Fantôme Development Team
